newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla fed cattle Wednesday roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla fed cattle Wednesday roundup - USDA.

text.p: Trade was moderate in the panhandle area Wednesday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers were steady.
Wk to date- 89,700 Week Ago - 110,300 Year Ago - 82,300
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1250 lbs 64.00. Pen Select, few Choice 2-3 1150 lbs 63.00.

Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1000-1150 lbs 64.00, couple pens North Plains 65.00. Select, few Choice 2-3 1000-1100 lbs 62.00-63.50. Pen Utility to Choice 2-4 1200 lbs including heiferettes 60.00.
Feedlots reporting good inquiry from buyers. Sales reported on 9,700 slaughter steers and 12,300 heifers; Week to date 89,700 which includes 34,500 formulated cattle to be shipped this week.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
